prompt: The default storage pool is getting crowded. Create a new storage pool called `fastdata`, then launch a Debian container named `bulk` whose root disk lives on that pool, attach an extra 1 GiB volume `extras` from the same pool to it, and show me the resulting config.
assertions: Storage pool <tok>fastdata exists in incus storage list
Instance <tok>bulk exists, RUNNING, and its root device pool property is <tok>fastdata
Custom volume <tok>extras exists on pool <tok>fastdata with size 1GiB
<tok>extras is attached to <tok>bulk as a disk device (visible in incus config show)
